This mechanism also explains how you're billed. Every request runs the model over the full context, so cost scales with
, and an agent making dozens of
calls pays for inference on each round trip. This is why context size is a cost question as well as a quality one.
"Why does the bill scale with usage instead of being a flat license?"
"You're paying for inference — every model provider request runs the model on the provider's hardware. Training already happened, but inference costs accrue per request, and a single
can expand into many requests when tools are called."
